title: hypericum quadrialatum
intro: Hypericum quadrialatum, commonly known as St. John's wort, is a flowering plant in the Hypericaceae family, known for its bright yellow flowers and medicinal properties. This plant has been used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, depression, and insomnia, due to its health benefits in regulating mood and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum quadrialatum include its ability to modulate neurotransmitters, such as serotonin and dopamine, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
